_why: forge station intents (contract station-forge section 5; contributed_by station, tie class station:* so they win over the commons ingest intent on this branch). Keywords are the contract's frozen lists, never widened to fit a prompt. Selftest prompts: router/intents.d/station.selftest.json, written after the keywords were frozen. First moves name the seven station workflows (built by equip-forge, 2026-10-16; tool-trial/upstream-intake workflows are named trial-run/intake-run because a workflow may not share a skill's name, DEC-forge-0002), each with an inline_gather. Equip added five skill intents (telemetry, noise, ci-audit, skill-build, maintain) for the gap skills, keywords frozen before their selftest prompts. Forge-setup (2026-10-16) added the setup intent: its keywords are tool-qualified ("set up evo", "install rea", ...) so the bare words set up / install keep routing elsewhere ("set up autoresearch" stays optimize); frozen in this file before router/intents.d/station.selftest.json got its setup prompts. The understand intent (forge-setup scope upgrade, 2026-10-16) routes to tools/station/understand.py; keywords frozen here before its selftest prompts.

intents.name: trial
intents.description: tool trial: N >= 5 frozen tasks without and with a tool (ProjectAtlas first), graded, verdict promote/park

intents.name: optimize
intents.description: evo autoresearch optimise loop with a holdout frozen first (evo-guard) and a re-measure on it

intents.name: wiki
intents.description: generate a wiki for a non-client repository with openwiki in a run-tree, telemetry off

intents.name: reverse
intents.description: reverse engineering with REA behind the re-legal-gate row

intents.name: intake
intents.description: take a new upstream into the stable: pin, licence, agent-file census, component-tree placement, ingest, route its skills

intents.name: arch
intents.description: architecture review: design it twice, then the improve-codebase-architecture report

intents.name: repin
intents.description: repin an upstream: repin report first, certain tests, lock row rewritten only after green

intents.name: telemetry
intents.description: audit a tool telemetry row and print the offline status + flip commands (CRITIC F11)

intents.name: noise
intents.description: measure the run-to-run spread of a baseline before claiming a gain

intents.name: ci-audit
intents.description: audit a CI or test suite for false passes with planted defects

intents.name: skill-build
intents.description: author a new kit skill or station workflow that earns its place

intents.name: maintain
intents.description: maintain the kit: sync check, listing budget, skill surface across branches

intents.name: setup
intents.description: one-step setup (or --remove) of rea, evo, openwiki or ProjectAtlas: prerequisites, pin, run tree, install at the pin, telemetry off, keys, smoke

intents.name: understand
intents.description: decipher and remember any target (path, owner~repo pin, or the kit): ProjectAtlas index + grounded openwiki wiki in one memory outside the station
